notes_for_editor: Sources agree on the 1932 build and the gone-by-1959 date. The record's 'abandoned 1959' (from idaho_fl) is recorded here as removed, because the three pages read say gone and do not say abandoned; the record's status 'gone' is consistent. Access level left unset: the sources give hike-in only. No staffing is documented by any source read; Idaho Fire Lookouts says so, and it is left out of the story. firelookout.com credits a photo to Harold Coffman, but no image URL was in the cache, so no photo is added. One web search found no other Bruin Hill source.
